data.name: Rajul
data.gender_notes: Rajul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Raj means king, and Ul means ruler. This name signifies a person who is a born leader and is destined to rule over others. The name Rajul carries the meaning “King, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Rajul usually hope their child will grow to embody king, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Rajul is a name that is deeply rooted in the spiritual traditions of Hinduism. It is believed that those named Rajul have a strong connection to the divine and are destined to lead others on a spiritual path.
data.etymology: Rajul belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “King, Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rajul total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_tamil.meaning: இல்லங்கையில் இருப்பது ராஜாவின் ஆசிரியம் (illangaiyil iruppathu rājāvīṉ āciriyam) - son of a king ruling from the left side

in_telugu.name: రాజుల్
in_telugu.meaning: ఆశేశ్యపై రాజ్యదోటోపై దేశియదోటోదు (āśēśyapai rājyadōṭōpai dēśiyadōṭōdu) - son of a king ruling in a distant land
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఆశేశ్ (āśēśya) - supreme + పై (pai) - in + రాజ్య (rājya) - kingdom + దేశియ (dēśi) - ruling + దోటోదు (dōṭōdu) - son

data.cultural_impact: The name Rajul carries an air of royalty and power. In Hindu culture, names are often indicative of the qualities and characteristics that are believed to be inherent in a person. The name Rajul suggests a person who is confident, bold, and assertive. It also signifies a person who is natural born leader, someone who enjoys Taking charge and being in control. People with this name are often seen as natural authorities and may insprire respect and fear.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rajul also holds spiritual significance in Hinduism. It reflects the person's potential to rule not just over people, but also over their own mind and inner world. The name Raj signifies the inner king – the Atman or the soul. The spiritual significance of the name Rajul thus encourages the person to strive towards becoming the master of their own mind and emotions. It inspires them to rule over their desires, to conquer their weaknesses, and to govern their thoughts and actions in a noble, righteous, and compassionate manner.
